notes.title: Update - 13 March 2023
notes.content:
Updates to the game include:
[list]
[*]There appears to be a lot of difficulty particularly with the 'Bottom of the Well' flag - have nerfed the crushers at the end to make it easier.
[*]Have updated the challenges in the mini-factory to make it easier.
[*]Fixed a couple of bugs relating to sound, music and tutorial videos.
[/list]

Thanks!

notes.title: End of Spike Mtn Playtest
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who participated in the [b]Spike Mtn Playtest[/b]! It was an extremely useful exercise for us and we gathered some great feedback. After a little break, we're going to start incorporating the following feedback into Spike Mtn:
[list]
[*] making the camera smoother;
[*] improve tutorial and teach the player the mechanics;
[*] lowering the learning curve; and
[*] better visual indicators for long jumps off the rope.
[/list]

We'll keep you updated on our progress!

Thanks again,
Elliot
